name: flipkart-mcp
description: Flipkart (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_flipkart_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FLIPKART_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_flipkart_access_token.description: Seller API access token of your Self Access Application (Seller Dashboard > Manage Profile > Developer Access): obtain it with GET https://api.flipkart.net/oauth-service/oauth/token?grant_type=client_credentials&scope=Seller_Api,Default using HTTP Basic appId:appSecret. It is valid about 60 days; replace it when calls start failing with 401 (the runtime cannot run Flipkart's GET token call itself).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe searches one APPROVED pre-dispatch shipment ({shipments[], hasMore, nextPageUrl}) to verify the token.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Search Shipments POST /v3/shipments/filter/ {filter: {type, states: [status], orderDate: {from: since}}, pagination: {pageSize ≤ 20}}. `status` is REQUIRED and selects the filter type: APPROVED|PACKING_IN_PROGRESS|PACKED|FORM_FAILED|READY_TO_DISPATCH (preDispatch) or SHIPPED|DELIVERED|PICKUP_COMPLETE (postDispatch). One row per SHIPMENT (raw.shipmentId); id/status/total/created_at come from its first order item (INR). Further pages are only reachable through raw.nextPageUrl.
